about_short_description.short_description: PropReturns is a platform that allows users to build wealth and earn passive income by investing in hand-picked Real Estate investments.

product.name: Commercial Real Estate Marketplace
product.description: A platform for buying, selling, and leasing commercial real estate properties with verified data and multiple property options.

product.name: Pre-leased Commercial Properties Investment
product.description: Investment opportunities in commercial properties that are already leased to tenants, generating rental income.

product.name: Property Listing and Brokerage Services
product.description: A service for property owners to list commercial properties for sale or lease and connect with verified investors and tenants.

product.name: PropReturns Intelligence (Data and Analytics)
product.description: A data service providing transaction data, rental analysis, and detailed insights on commercial properties.

product.name: Fractional Ownership Investment
product.description: An investment option allowing users to buy fractional shares in commercial real estate assets to earn rental income and returns.

product.name: Financial Calculators
product.description: Online tools to calculate financial metrics such as ROI and loan EMI for real estate investments.
